title: Archie #3
desc: WOOF WOOF! ARCHIE'S GOODEST BOY IS ON THE LOOSE . . . IN A VERY SPECIAL ISSUE FOR THE AGES! Writer extraordinaire Ben H. Winters (Benjamin, EC's Cruel Universe) and sensational artist Nick Cagnetti (Spirit of the Shadows, Pink Lemonade) take you on a majestic tour de farce of Riverdale through a dog's eyes . . . guest-starring, well, everyone in the whole dang town!When Archie's faithful, furry companion Vegas slips free during his Saturday bath, he takes us—and poor Archie, too—on a wet and wild tour of Riverdale . . . down the shady streets, into the side door, out into the alley, back into the laundromat, then through the fanciest restaurant in town and . . . well, you get the idea! There's no slowing down, even when Betty, Moose, Reggie, Jughead, and Veronica all join the chase. It's truly a dog's day out as Vegas's unpredictable path weaves into the everyday lives of Riverdale's colorful townsfolk . . . revealing the explosive surprises and quiet victories that keep a small town ticking!
